The smallest such n is 8. To see this, let P(n) = 1!·2!···(n−1)! and R(n) = P(n)/(n!)², so the condition is R(n) > 1.

Since P(n+1) = P(n)·n!, the ratio updates as

R(n+1) = R(n) · n!/(n+1)².

Starting from R(1) = 1 (empty product over 1!²):

- R(2) = 1·1/4 = 1/4
- R(3) = (1/4)·2/9 = 1/18
- R(4) = (1/18)·6/16 = 1/48
- R(5) = (1/48)·24/25 = 1/50
- R(6) = (1/50)·120/36 = 1/15
- R(7) = (1/15)·720/49 = 48/49 < 1
- R(8) = (48/49)·5040/64 = 241920/3136 ≈ 77.1 > 1

R(n) is below 1 for n ≤ 7 and first exceeds 1 at n = 8.

ANSWER: 8
